title: Access Security Event Token claims (RFC 8417, SSF 1.0)
description: The claims of every SET Access sends, signed as a JWS of typ secevent+jwt with the realm key for SSF push and poll, and carried unsigned as CloudEvent data in the webhook profile. `events` has exactly one member; its key is the event type (an Access URN, or a CAEP 1.0 / RISC 1.0 type URI) and its value matches that event's schema. There is no top-level `sub` and no `exp` (TN-39).

jti.description: The dedup key of every channel: the event id, or for a CAEP/RISC copy an id derived per receiver (TI-RT10).

txn.description: The transaction the event comes from (TN-39): the Access event id, shared by an Access event and its CAEP counterpart; per receiver for an identity plane signal.

sub_id.description: Subject identifier (RFC 9493): `opaque` for Access events, `iss_sub` with the receiver's own pairwise `sub` for identity plane signals, `uri` naming the realm issuer for a realm-wide signal (CR-27).

access_tenant.description: The tenant the event happened in, by its opaque tnt_ id (OP-149 m.15 (i)). Present only on a platform product's subscription, which receives the events of every tenant (OP-149 m.17 (e)); iss and aud are then the platform realm's and its subscriber's.

access_position.description: On a CAEP or RISC SET, whose event body is fixed by its standard: the position of the Access event it copies, or of the identity plane signal. An Access event carries it in its own body.

The event's monotone version field (OP-22): it only grows within its source, the domain for an authority event and the issuer for an identity event. A receiver that has applied a later or equal position re-queries instead of applying this event.
